questions.question:
Identify the correct sentence that uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase.

Adverbial phrase: Only after the meeting did she realize the importance of the discussion.
options: Only after the meeting did she realize the importance of the discussion.
After the meeting only did she realize the importance of the discussion.
Only after the meeting she realized the importance of the discussion.
After the meeting only she realized the importance of the discussion.
questions.answer: Only after the meeting did she realize the importance of the discussion.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail about the project's success?
options: It was the innovative approach that led to the project's success.
The innovative approach was it that led to the project's success.
The project's success was due to the innovative approach.
Due to the innovative approach, the project's success was achieved.
questions.answer: It was the innovative approach that led to the project's success.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation in the past.

Situation: If I had known about the event, I would have attended.
options: If I had known about the event, I would have attended.
If I had known about the event, I would attend.
If I knew about the event, I would have attended.
If I know about the event, I would have attended.
questions.answer: If I had known about the event, I would have attended.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly uses ellipsis to omit the redundant part in the conditional clause?
options: If you had studied harder, you would have passed the exam.
If you had studied harder, you would have passed the exam.
If you had studied harder, you would have passed the exam.
If you had studied harder, you would have passed the exam.
questions.answer: If you had studied harder, you would have passed the exam.

questions.question:
Identify the sentence that appropriately uses formal register and complex sentence structure to discuss the implications of the policy change.

Policy change: The government's decision to reduce corporate taxes is expected to stimulate economic growth, although it may also lead to increased inequality.
options: The government's decision to reduce corporate taxes is expected to stimulate economic growth, although it may also lead to increased inequality.
It is expected that the government's decision to reduce corporate taxes will stimulate economic growth, but this might also lead to increased inequality.
The reduction of corporate taxes by the government is expected to stimulate economic growth, but it may also lead to increased inequality.
It is likely that the government's decision to reduce corporate taxes will stimulate economic growth, although this might also lead to increased inequality.
questions.answer: It is expected that the government's decision to reduce corporate taxes will stimulate economic growth, but this might also lead to increased inequality.
